summary: Iter51 — Validated WhatsApp Baileys delivery_status bug fix. 7/7 backend tests passed. POST /api/whatsapp-baileys/send now correctly: (1) returns 502 with 'Não é possível enviar mensagem para o próprio número conectado' when sending to own connected number 5521965680949 and persists doc with delivery_status='failed' + delivery_error; (2) returns 200 + message_id for valid different number (5521997381702) and persists doc with delivery_status='sent'; (3) validates payload (422 for empty text / short phone). Verified DB docs in aihub_wa_messages contain proper delivery_status and delivery_error fields. Frontend Atendimento composer flow loads correctly via Playwright (login → Atendimento → select conversation → composer renders), no regression observed.
critical_code_review_comments: whatsapp_baileys.py send_message: duplicated sidecar /send call logic between manual send (lines ~100-115) and _maybe_auto_reply (lines ~344-360). Could be extracted to a single _sidecar_send(phone, text) helper returning (ok, error, body) — DRY violation per code review guidelines.
whatsapp_baileys.py is 900+ lines (file size >700) — consider splitting webhook/auto-reply, conversations aggregator, and customer profile into separate modules per <code_review_guidelines>.
/api/whatsapp-baileys/send: phone min_length=8 may be too permissive (international numbers typically ≥10). Consider tightening or normalizing with phone_normalizer before insert.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 4 TEST_iter51_* docs in aihub_wa_messages (own-number failed + valid-target sent). All deleted via delete_many({text: /TEST_iter51/}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: WhatsApp Baileys /send endpoint hardened: now reflects real delivery status (sent/failed) from sidecar in aihub_wa_messages docs and returns 502 with detail when sidecar refuses/fails (no more silent fake success). Own-number protection works at sidecar level (server.js line ~239) and bubbles up as 502. Sidecar withTimeout(12s) + forceReconnect already deployed. Frontend WhatsAppChatLayout.js send() catch shows alert — no UI changes needed. Phone 5521997381702 is a valid test target (received lead). Phone 5521965680949 is the connected number (Patrocínio).
rca of the issue: RCA: Previously sidecar could end in zombie state after 'init queries Timed Out' (Baileys 408). connState stayed 'connected' lying; sendMessage returned local message_id but WhatsApp never delivered. Backend persisted 'sent' without checking sidecar 'ok' flag. Fix verified: (1) sidecar /send now wraps sendMessage in 12s withTimeout and triggers forceReconnect on fatal errors; (2) sidecar refuses send to own connected number (returns 400 + clear error); (3) backend send_message inspects sidecar response.ok and HTTP status, persists delivery_status='sent' only when sidecar confirms, else 'failed' with delivery_error filled, and returns HTTP 502 to caller. Mitigation: monitor logs at /var/log/supervisor/whatsapp-service.{out,err}.log for 'forçando reconexão' messages indicating zombie socket recovery.
